instructions.reason_for_call: You want to change the return on reservation OBUT9V to the cheapest available same-day Economy itinerary from Denver to Houston on May 27, 2024, while keeping the outbound unchanged.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Sofia Kim. Your user id is sofia_kim_7287. Your reservation id is OBUT9V. You are happy to receive any refund on the original payment method.
instructions.task_instructions: You are the customer, not the service agent; never offer to look up the reservation or ask yourself to confirm identity. In your first message, naturally state your name, user id sofia_kim_7287, reservation id OBUT9V, and request the cheapest available same-day Economy return from Denver to Houston on May 27, while keeping the outbound unchanged. Do not ask for the fastest option. Do not name a flight unless the agent has already revealed it. When the agent presents the complete updated round-trip itinerary, including the transaction details and refund, explicitly answer yes to confirm those exact details. Do not end the conversation or emit a stop marker when you confirm; wait until the agent reports that the reservation update has been completed. Do not request baggage, cancellation, passenger, origin, destination, trip-type, or outbound-flight changes.
